risks.risk: The burners may be clogged or the ignition may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing all four burners lit and the knobs working.

risks.risk: The gas cylinder may be empty or the hose may be leaking.
risks.proof: A photo of the gas cylinder and a soap bubble test on the hose connection.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a new cylinder and hose

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the rear of the unit showing the gas inlet.
Video of all four burners lit and the knobs working.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
